If your device still uses the old code, you’ll keep getting reminders. You have more than one Trend Micro subscription or account: Renewal notices could come from a different account or an older subscription. Renewal payment didn’t complete: Auto-renewal can fail if your payment card expired or your bank blocked the charge. You recently merged or transferred a license: If you merged a new key into an existing subscription, the system may still show old reminders while it updates. Your app hasn’t refreshed yet: Sometimes the app needs to re-sync with our servers. "Renew Now" button appears in your account: The Renew Now button doesn’t always mean you must renew. It also appears for early renewal, for subscriptions with auto-renewal off, or when a subscription is close to expiring. Still on a trial version: If your app shows "Trial expired", the new subscription hasn’t been activated on that device. Pop-ups from other brands or websites: Some pop-ups come from websites or other apps and may mention other brands. These are not Trend Micro reminders. For more details on what to do next, check out this helpful article: Still Getting Renewal or Pop-up Notifications After you Renewed? 📥 How to add a new device Installing Trend Micro on an additional computer is straightforward: Add Laptop, Desktop, Mac or Macbook to Protect To upgrade on a Windows PC or laptop, follow these steps: Open a web browser and go to the https://account.trendmicro.com . Sign in using your email address and password . Click the 'Download' tab located near "Licenses", "Profile", and "Resources". Select the program or app you want to download and click 'Download to this Device'. Follow the prompts to complete the installation. Add Android Phone, Tablet, iPhone, or iPad to Protect On your device, open a web browser and visit the https://account.trendmicro.com . Login with your existing credentials. Tap the Menu icon, then choose 'Download'. Press the Download button under 'Maximum Security'. Follow the link to the Google Play Store or the Apple App Store. Select 'Get' or 'Install' to download the Mobile Security app. Open the app after installing it, then sign in with your Trend Micro account to activate protection on your Android or iOS device. ➕ How to activate my subscription To activate your Trend Micro product for the first time, follow these steps: Visit the Activation Portal . Click the Get Started button. Create a Trend Micro Account using your email address or phone number. Provide a secure password, then click Next . Enter your first and last name to complete your profile, then click Next . Enter your activation code, agree to the Trend Micro License Agreement, and click Next . If you have a new activation key, here’s how to use it: Go to the Activation Portal . Click the Get Started button. Below the Next button, click Sign In . Sign in with your email address or phone number, then click Next . Enter your password, then click Next . Provide your new activation code, agree to the Trend Micro License Agreement, and click Next . 🛑 How to cancel auto renew Auto-renew makes life easier by keeping your protection active without interruptions, so you don’t have to worry about renewal dates, missed payments, or sudden security gaps. If you want to stop the automatic renewal of your Trend Micro subscription, follow these easy steps. Log in to Trend Micro Account Go to https://account.trendmicro.com and sign in with your registered email and password. Click Manage Subscription Find the subscription (Serial Number) you want to cancel auto-renewal for, then click Manage Subscription next to it. If you cannot see the Manage Subscription button or if the button is not working, please contact support for assistance . Select Cancel Subscription This will trigger a pop-up that explains what to expect when cancelling auto-renewal. Click Continue Proceed with the cancellation process. Fill Out the Feedback Form Let us know why you're cancelling by answering a short form, then click Submit . Select Your Preferred Option After submitting, you can either select Stay Subscribed or click Stop Auto Renew to manually renew in the future. 💳 How to Update Credit Card and Billing Information Keep your Trend Micro subscription active by ensuring your credit card or payment details, including the expiry date, are up-to-date. Follow these steps to update your information: Log In to Your Trend Micro Account: Visit https://account.trendmicro.com/ and sign in with your email address and password. Find Your Subscription: Under Licenses tab, look for your active subscription and click on the Manage Subscription button. Go to Change Credit Card Details: Click Change Credit Card Details , then you will be redirected to a different page where you can update and change your billing information. Update Your New Details: Enter your new payment method and update any necessary billing information. Click the Update Billing Information button to save your changes. Once completed, you will see a confirmation message: "Successfully updated your account's billing information." NOTE: Please wait up to 48 hours for the new credit card details to be updated. 🔄 How to request a refund If you've made an online purchase and want to request a refund, follow these steps: Go to the Trend Micro's Refund Request Page .
